name: International Space Station
description: Sea-level air (21 % O₂, 101.3 kPa) in microgravity, with forced ventilation.
source: ISS cabin specification; FLEX and ACME ran at these conditions

name: Lunar Gateway
description: Intermediate exploration atmosphere (10.2 psi, 26.5 % O₂) in microgravity.
note: Gateway’s final setpoint is not confirmed; this is the NASA exploration option.

name: Moon surface base
description: Exploration atmosphere (8.2 psi, 34 % O₂) that shortens spacesuit pre-breathe, in lunar gravity.
source: NASA Exploration Atmospheres Working Group; challenge brief (≥30 % O₂ at ≤10.2 psi)
note: NASA has not fixed this atmosphere; it is the working assumption.

name: Mars surface base
description: Assumed to use the same atmosphere as the Moon base, in Mars gravity.
source: Assumption (no NASA Mars habitat atmosphere yet)
note: Assumed equal to the Moon base.
